row.title: Knowledge graphs: the platform runs DATAGRAPH-1, tenants with domain data run the shared engine
row.body: The platform keeps DATAGRAPH-1 (seed step knowledge-graph, zero-config over every table). Tenants with domain data run seed/worker/src/knowledge.js with their own mappers (built rows in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json, vendored through doctrine/tenant-repos.json). The two engines share kg_* table names with different schemas, so never both on one D1.
